Sam (Customer Success): Kestrel needs a short-term APAC throughput bump + egress allowlist for a pilot next week — seeing retries in their telemetry. Can ops provision? ticket infra-4567.
Priya (Support Eng): Logged infra-4567. Can you paste the IP ranges and exact start/end window?
Sam (Customer Success): They sent: 34.120.0.0/16, 45.33.128.0/18. Prefer ap-southeast-1 edge. Need burst 1000 rps for 72h starting 2026-04-05T00:00:00Z.
Leo (Network Ops): We can add allowlist + temp RL bump. Confirm org id and whether they're on Hosted vs Dedicated.
Sam (Customer Success): Org = kestrel-data (org_klm123). Hosted API. FYI renewal in ~6 weeks — sales flagged this pilot as a renewal signal. Latency is a big concern for them.
Marta (Solutions): Suggest canary route to ap-southeast-1 + fallback to us-west-2, and prime prefix cache for common prompts. Also consider brief quantization tweak if cost spikes.
Priya (Support Eng): Ops runbook snippet:
```
allowlist_add org_klm123 34.120.0.0/16
allowlist_add org_klm123 45.33.128.0/18
rate_limit_update org_klm123 1000rps window=72h start=2026-04-05T00:00:00Z
route_add org_klm123 region=ap-southeast-1 canary=true fallback=us-west-2
```
Leo (Network Ops): I'll schedule this in tonight's maintenance window at 22:00 UTC unless anyone objects. Note: ap-southeast edge will need warmup.
Alex (Eng Infra): Heads up — provisioning extra edge capacity + kernel warmup could be 18-24h to hit steady-state. Start provisioning by 2026-04-03 latest for a 2026-04-05 pilot.
Sam (Customer Success): I'll message the customer and ask if they can nudge pilot start if we can't finish warmup. Also collecting their SRE runbook for contact info.
deploy-bot: Change request infra-4567 moved to 'in-progress' by Leo
Sam (Customer Success): Follow-ups: 1) post completion verification steps (target p95 < 200ms), 2) confirm burst billing and notify AE, 3) add renewal playbook flag.
Marta (Solutions): I'll draft a one-pager for AE + verification checklist.
Alex (Eng Infra): After apply I'll post quick perf checks: curl latency, token throughput, cache hit %.
Priya (Support Eng): Sam—please add Kestrel on-call contact for pilot monitoring.
Sam (Customer Success): Their on-call: kyle@kestrel.ai, SRE Ana (ana_k). Added to ticket.
Leo (Network Ops): Completed config apply at 2026-04-02T22:10:00Z; rules added, warmup started. Monitoring dashboards open.
Alex (Eng Infra): Warmup metrics as of 22:30 UTC — tcp connect <15ms for 92% to ap-southeast-1, cache primed with top-50 prefixes.
Sam (Customer Success): Notified customer; they acknowledged: "Appreciate the quick turn — pilot will start 2026-04-05; will report issues." :party_parrot: 
Marta (Solutions): Flagging this as priority for renewal outreach. Will sync w/ AE on messaging cadence.
Sam (Customer Success): Please drop a final completion note in infra-4567 and mark renewal risk mitigated.
deploy-bot: Ticket infra-4567 status updated to 'done' by Leo
Sam (Customer Success): :thumbsup:
